title: WALTEUR Premortem
description: Premortem: at least five ways the project could fail, each rated for likelihood and impact, tied to a mitigation task, with residual risk recorded. CONSTRAINT: any High-likelihood AND High-impact scenario REQUIRES a mitigation_task_id (a downstream gate rejects an unmitigated High x High).

category.description: Failure category (e.g. security, data-loss, scaling, dependency, adoption, cost).

mitigation_task_id.description: ID of the task that mitigates this scenario. REQUIRED when likelihood=high AND impact=high.

residual_risk.description: Risk that remains after the mitigation is applied.

allOf.$comment: A High-likelihood AND High-impact scenario REQUIRES mitigation_task_id.
